import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import io

# Prepare the data
csv_data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# Data cleaning and feature engineering
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
df[['Systolic', 'Diastolic']] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/', expand=True).astype(int)

# Set up the visualization style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
sns.set_context("talk")

# Create a 2x2 subplot grid
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(18, 14))
fig.suptitle('Comprehensive Health and Sleep Analysis', fontsize=24, weight='bold')

# --- Plot 1: Sleep Quality vs. Duration, colored by Sleep Disorder ---
palette1 = {'None': '#4CAF50', 'Sleep Apnea': '#F44336'}
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='Sleep Duration',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    size='Stress Level',
    sizes=(100, 400),
    palette=palette1,
    ax=axes[0, 0],
    style='Occupation',
    s=200 # Base size for style marker
)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Quality vs. Duration by Disorder', fontsize=16, weight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=14)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=14)
axes[0, 0].legend(title='Legend', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')


# --- Plot 2: Key Health Metrics by Occupation ---
df_melted = df.melt(
    id_vars='Occupation',
    value_vars=['Daily Steps', 'Physical Activity Level'],
    var_name='Metric',
    value_name='Value'
)
sns.barplot(
    data=df_melted,
    x='Occupation',
    y='Value',
    hue='Metric',
    ax=axes[0, 1],
    palette='viridis'
)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Activity Levels by Occupation', fontsize=16, weight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=14)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Value', fontsize=14)
axes[0, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=15)


# --- Plot 3: Cardiovascular Health by BMI Category ---
palette3 = {'Normal': 'royalblue', 'Overweight': 'orange', 'Obese': 'crimson'}
sns.stripplot(
    data=df,
    x='BMI Category',
    y='Heart Rate',
    hue='BMI Category',
    palette=palette3,
    s=15,
    ax=axes[1, 0],
    order=['Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese'],
    jitter=0.1
)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Heart Rate by BMI Category', fontsize=16, weight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=14)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=14)
axes[1, 0].get_legend().remove()


# --- Plot 4: Blood Pressure Analysis ---
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='Systolic',
    y='Diastolic',
    hue='BMI Category',
    style='Sleep Disorder',
    palette=palette3,
    s=300,
    ax=axes[1, 1],
    hue_order=['Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
)
# Add reference lines for blood pressure categories
axes[1, 1].axhline(80, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=1)
axes[1, 1].axvline(120, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=1)
axes[1, 1].axvline(130, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=1, alpha=0.7)
axes[1, 1].text(118, 91, 'Normal', verticalalignment='center', horizontalalignment='right', color='gray')
axes[1, 1].text(138, 91, 'Elevated/High', verticalalignment='center', horizontalalignment='right', color='gray')

axes[1, 1].set_title('Blood Pressure by BMI and Sleep Disorder', fontsize=16, weight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Systolic Pressure (mmHg)', fontsize=14)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Diastolic Pressure (mmHg)', fontsize=14)
axes[1, 1].legend(title='Categories', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')


# Final adjustments and save
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96])
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
